spans.text: Cough... Cough...
The hovering guns are blown up one after the other, and the shadowy figure of Death finally crashes to the ground.
Bang-bang-bang!
ST AR-15 puts in a final burst of bullets.
What are you waiting for?
How did you get here?
By trampling over M4's corpse.
Don't be cheeky with me!
Ka-chak—SOP-II reloads her weapon.
Did Elisa somehow summon you?
Maybe she did, maybe she didn't. It makes no difference either way.
The Mastermind will lead us to victory.
As for you, Griffin scum, you are losers no matter which world it is...
Scarecrow's sneer remains even as her eyes grow dim and she seemingly drifts off into a sweet dream...
Crunch.
ST AR-15 crumples up Scarecrow's lifeless card.
...Dammit.
We should've strung her up and interrogated her!
Doesn't matter. Judging by our previous dealings with Scarecrow, she wouldn't have divulged any useful information anyway.
Humph, she got off easy!
Flutter...
A card descends from the sky and takes the card that has floated out of Scarecrow's disintegrating body.
Esteemed ladies, forgive me for being late...
The card kneels on the ground and bows as she hands the trophy over to RO with both hands.
Who are you...?
The Fae of Cups, your most faithful servant. Please allow me to do your bidding.
Don't trust her!
The Empress cries out woefully. The Moon is lying on the ground, no longer moving.
We also trusted the guidance of the Fae of Swords... until she caused the ground to collapse and the world to shrink rapidly...
Forcing us to clash and kill each other...
I can vouch for that... Please believe the Empress!
Don't blame the Fae of Sword's individual action on all of the other faes!
I AM intent on serving my chosen ladies faithfully!
Why have you chosen us?
Because you are all beautiful, well-spoken, approachable, and have justice in your hearts!
On top of that, you're all super strong!
What's in it for you for serving us?
It's my purpose! Please don't make me out to be some despicable villain who only approaches you for some petty gains!
Tsk.
If your idea of showing sincerity is to keep spewing lies, then I don't see how we can work together.
Please leave.
We're telling you to scram! Heard that?!
But...
Whoosh!
She finds herself staring down three dark gun muzzles.
(Sobs) Fine, I'm going! I'm going, alright?!
The broken-hearted card disappears.
She's gone...
Please stop crying. We should be safe for now.
Thank you...
Yes, I hold the card of the Empress and wield the power of summoning other Major Arcana cards to my side.
That's amazing! I wonder what power my card gives me...
Are you working together?
She is the Hermit. We decided to team up...
I'm still alive thanks to her.
I hold the card of the Hermit, which gives me the ability to see all active Arcanas within range.
From what I understand of the game, it would be best for holders of Major Arcana cards to keep their powers secret, no?
Huh...? Why?
...Theoretically speaking, we really shouldn't be revealing our own powers.
So why have you just gone and spilled everything?
I would like to make a deal with you.
What deal?
I am willing to aid you with my power in exchange for your protection over the Empress and myself.
We need protection since neither of us possess any decent combat capability, and the powers of our cards are both defense-oriented.
Hermit...
...We are a T-Doll squad at the Griffin base. It has always been our duty to protect weaker Dolls.
But much as I'd like to say that, common sense cannot be applied to this world.
RO, should we bring them along?
Let's stay together. We're here to find an important teammate, so we can use all the help we can get.
However, we can't promise we'd keep you safe at all times. If push comes to shove, I will prioritize the safety of my team.
That's good enough.
The Hermit takes the Empress' hand. They leave with the AR Team after saying a final goodbye to the remains of the Moon.
Come, Fae of Swords. Come over here.
Then put down your shears first!
What are you afraid of? Aren't we good friends?
Good friends, my ass! That's how you tricked me and pushed me onto a glue trap last time!
All water under the bridge! How can we find a better future if we keep looking back?
Get some perspective!
Why do you sound just like the Fae of Wands?
That's probably because...
What are the two of you up to?!
We have a great plan that will give us a triumphant victory at the final performance presentation conference.
...What's the plan?
The Fae of Wands has high hopes for that VIP of hers. In fact, she is staking everything on that one-eyed girl.
The ones that I've got my eyes on are also pretty decent. You catch my drift?
The two of you are forming an alliance to wipe out all the other participants first before duking it out between yourselves...
Exactly. This way, whether it is the one-eyed lady or my team that survives, we both win.
What about the Fae of Pentacles' VIP? That white-haired midget is surprisingly impressive.
As far as I know, she's the player with the best performance so far.
Are you happy to let the Fae of Pentacles hog all the glory? That brat has been at the top of the performance chart for so long, it should be our turn.
Don't you remember? Last time she won best employee, the wish she had Her Demonic Highness grant her was...
For us to bark like dogs for a week!
...Don't remind me. I'm still mad about that.
Then your choice should be pretty obvious.
I understand. What do you need me to do?
Feed your two small fries to the big fish.
Those two? What would that achieve?
You don't get it. The AR Team hasn't made a single kill yet.
Who cares about justice and fairness? We must offer them a first taste of blood to prime their bloodthirst.
And baiting them with the two small fries will do?
You know how those cunning game developers offer you a super generous $1 gift package right at the start? Once you fall for it and make your first purchase, you won't be able to stop!
In a similar vein, anyone who kills regularly knows that the first kill is always the hardest. But once you've started...
Everything will naturally follow...
And thus, a new deal has been struck under the two cards' sinister cackling.
Heavy, resounding footsteps draw closer slowly.
After a bout of frenzied carnage and barrage, the battlefield is now filled with nothing but silence and desolation.
Miss M16, I know you don't want to see me, but I earnestly implore you not to proceed any further. Please find a different route...
Give me a reason.
There is a formidable adversary ahead. I'm worried that you'll...
Ha.
M16 gazes into the distance. The corpses littering the ground stretch all the way to the horizon.
What if I insist on meeting her?
Don't you wish to see Miss M4? If you still want that wish granted...
I sincerely ask you to grind for more EXP before doing so...
M16 stops in her tracks, her cold eyes boring into the obstacle ahead.
There's no time.
What?
Whoosh.
A thin card is shredded, and its pieces scatter all around.
You came.
It's been a while.
Standing on the backlit hill, M16 can just about make out Elisa's gloomy features.
I see you haven't been able to find M4 either.
This is an arduous task. Allow me to free you from it.
Elisa seemingly dissolves in the wind and disappears.
Ka-chak. M16 reloads.
Gripping her rifle tightly, she scans her surroundings cautiously.
Your reflexes have gotten even quicker, M16.
Bang-bang-bang!
A string of decisive gunshots ring out as bullets whizz in the direction of the voice.
However, a faint barrier forms mid-air, completely neutralizing the ferocious attack.
I will not let you find M4.
M16 stalks toward Elisa...
Oh, you're back.
That freaking Fae of Pentacles has got to be cheating with a VIP like that!
I died before I could even say my last words!
Don't be mad. Look, I've got us yet another ally.
If it's any consolation, the way you died was pretty cool.
Ahem, now let's talk about the plan—the plan!
Fae of Wands, we're about to fast-forward to the final phase.
Now?
Yes, we can't let the Fae of Pentacles' VIP keep up with the bloodbath.
Let's just kickstart the final phase and bring them together. Miss M16 will definitely work together with the AR Team.
Right.
As for the rules, I'll have to make some small adjustments...
For the sake of bloodying the AR Team's hands, it will all be worth it!
Let us first welcome everyone will a big round of applause! We also have some very exciting news—
Tarot Paradise is about to enter the culling stage!
In the next five minutes, all Major Arcanas will be tallied in each area.
If there are fewer than five Major Arcanas in an area, everyone within that area can proceed to the next stage.
If there are five or more Major Arcanas in the same area, then everyone within that area will be punished... by death.
The countdown begins... now!
In the darkness, speckles of starlight weave into a small path that leads into the unknown.
Colt M1851N and the AR Team trio stand frozen in this surreal void.
What's the meaning of this? This rule didn't exist before!
Those damn bastards are just forcing us to kill each other outright!
The Hermit is about to say something when the Empress grasps her gently on the arm and shakes her head.
I've already used up my power. I won't be of any use to you even if you keep me around. I'll only be a hindrance.
...Empress!
What are you doing?
Please take the Hermit with you.
Oh my, I really didn't want to see this.
The utterly merciless card appears nonchalantly in mid-air.
You dare show your face?!
Don't be mad, Miss SOP-II. I'm here to help you solve your problem.
Go on then! What do you suggest?!
It's quite simple. If you must pick one to kill between the Empress and the Hermit, I'd personally keep the Hermit alive.
Is that supposed to be helpful?!
SOP-II whacks the Fae of Cups with her butt stock.
Ow! Don't hit me! Stop it!
I'm just pointing out the best course of action if I were in your shoes. If I were with the Hermit and the Empress, I'd also tell them to kill one of you.
I may not have any emotions, but I understand why you're so reluctant to be parted.
You are all sisters who have gone through fire and water together. It's only natural that you'd loathe seeing one of you die...
Don't listen to her. She's trying to turn us against each other.
It's not like I want to... but you only have 15 seconds left...
What?!
Hey! Stop the countdown!
What are you waiting for? If you keep dawdling, you are all going to die when the timer runs out, you know?
Ka-chak.
The Hermit points her gun at her own temple.
Please protect the Empress till the very end.
Hermit!
Bang!
The Empress throws a smoke grenade at the Hermit. The two Dolls disappear in the rapidly spreading white smoke...
Hermit! Empress!
What are you doing?! Stop messing about!
Don't go in there.
Bang!
With a single gunshot, everything finally quiets down.
